description: This file contains utility functions for email handling, including rendering email templates, sending emails, generating and verifying password reset tokens, and creating various email content data structures.

classes.name: EmailData
classes.description: Data class representing email content with HTML content and subject.

methods.name: render_email_template
methods.description: Renders an email template with provided context.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Sends an email using configured SMTP settings.

methods.name: generate_test_email
methods.description: Creates a test email data object.

methods.name: generate_reset_password_email
methods.description: Creates a password reset email data object with a link containing a token.

methods.name: generate_new_account_email
methods.description: Creates a new account notification email data object.

methods.name: generate_password_reset_token
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for password reset with expiration.

methods.name: verify_password_reset_token
methods.description: Verifies and decodes a password reset JWT token.
